title: Fill in the blanks of an algorithm
unitTests:
static_assert(std::is_abstract_v<Report> && !std::is_abstract_v<SalesReport>);
struct Plain : Report { std::string body() const override { return "body
"; } };

TEST("sales report") { const SalesReport r{ 12, 500 }; CHECK_EQ(r.generate(), "== SALES ==
Units: 12
Revenue: 6000
== END ==
"); }
TEST("through the base class") { const SalesReport r{ 1, 99 }; const Report& base{ r }; CHECK_EQ(base.generate(), "== SALES ==
Units: 1
Revenue: 99
== END ==
"); }
TEST("defaults are used when not overridden") { CHECK_EQ(Plain{}.generate(), "== REPORT ==
body
== END ==
"); }
